The club's name "Epitsentr" is after the Ukrainian brand of home improvement wholesale stores [[Epitsentr K]]. Besides football, the Dunaivtsi club also fields its professional [[futsal]] team ''Verest''. They are currently playing in the [[Ukrainian Premier League]]. Epitsentr officially moved from [[Dunaivtsi]] to [[Kamianets-Podilskyi]] in 2024.[https://sportarena.com/uk/footboll/ukraina-pervaya-liga/fk-epitsentr-u-novomu-sezoni-predstavlyatime/ ФК Епіцентр у новому сезоні представлятиме Кам’янець-Подільський].
